detail: Typed response-contract derivation now covers Python, Ruby, and PHP, closing the last per-language response-reader gap after Go, Rust, Java, and C#. FastAPI response_model and status_code, HTTPException, JSONResponse, and Flask tuple returns state the success body and statuses; Rails render json status forms and head :no_content; Laravel response()->json, abort, noContent, and literal array returns. Each reader claims a shape only when statically provable, states status where declared, marks reference or Eloquent or ActiveModel shapes presence-only, and abstains at handler or class level on dynamic dispatch, so the response-shape and response-status oracles arm for these frameworks without fabricating a contract. Verified live: reproit init on a real FastAPI app derived typed 200 and 201 bodies and a 404 with honest presence-only Optional fields.
